overview:
**Fire danger remains Low today, held down by cool temps, light winds, and low fuel dryness (ERC 39%, BI 37%).**
- Danger stays Low through the next 7 days, with ERC drifting slightly lower into early December (39% today to 33% by Dec 2).
- Weather driver: mild and mostly sunny through Thanksgiving/Friday, with a Friday wind increase (gusts to 25 mph) before a cooler, breezier weekend brings light mountain rain/snow.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met — no elevated fire-behavior concerns today.
- No active fire restrictions are reported in the Montrose-area counties; only standard year-round burning rules apply.
- The Gold Mountain Fire, which burned 39,747 acres north of Ouray, has reached 100% containment after mop-up confirmed no remaining heat, though burn-scar hazards persist nearby.
